question: A seed company packs 202 seeds in every packet, with 5 packets in a box, and a farmer bought 8 boxes. She checks her fields twice a week. She divided the seeds equally among her 4 plots. In the first plot she also sowed 59 seeds saved from last year. Every seed in that plot grew into a plant with 9 peas. How many peas did the first plot produce?

In the morning a courier office had 47 minutes of deliveries on its list, and 76 more minutes were added before noon. In the afternoon another 13 minutes were added, bringing the round to a little over two hours. In the evening a second round of exactly the same length was added, making 2 rounds. All the delivery time was then shared equally among 4 drivers, so Ana's share was exactly the same as Ben's. How many minutes of deliveries did Ana get?

In the morning Cara put 71 cents into her jar and then 17 cents more. In the afternoon she added 26 cents. In the evening she added 73 cents, bringing that day's saving to a little under two dollars. She saved exactly the same amount on each of 6 days. How many cents did Cara save over those 6 days?

A bakery uses 71 grams of dough for each roll, packs 3 rolls in a bag, and puts 5 bags in an order. It adds 48 grams of seeds and 31 grams of glaze to every order, and lets the dough rest for half an hour. The bakery has 9 ovens. A hotel places 5 orders. How many grams of dough, seeds and glaze go into the hotel's orders?

Ewa earns 155 cents a day from her paper round. Each day she spends 35 cents on a snack, earns 65 cents walking a neighbour's dog for half an hour, and gets 54 cents from returning bottles, and she saves what is left. She does this 7 days a week for 3 weeks. How many cents does Ewa save?

Ian gets 105 cents a day in pocket money. Every day he spends 18 cents on a bun, earns 48 cents washing dishes, gets 66 cents for weeding, and receives 34 cents from his grandfather, who visits twice a week. He saves everything he has left over each day for 7 days. How many cents does Ian save?

In the morning a lemonade stand had 85 cups ready, and the owner made 53 more. 7 cups were knocked over and spilled. In the afternoon every cup was sold for 7 cents. In the evening a customer came back and left a 25-cent tip. How many cents did the stand take in?

Jen had 169 minutes of talk time, nearly three hours, and the company added 4 bonus minutes. She made a 16-minute call to her dentist and a 74-minute call to her mother. She then spoke to her friend for 57 minutes, about half of which was about football. She bought a top-up of 50 minutes. How many minutes of talk time does Jen have?

Ida is paid 198 cents an hour, but 129 cents of each hour's pay goes to her union, leaving her less than a dollar an hour. She works 7 hours a day for 6 days. Her shift starts at 8. Ida shares her own pay equally among herself and her 5 workmates, keeping 1 of the 6 equal shares, so her workmate Jon gets exactly the same as Ida keeps. Ida then receives a 70-cent tip. At the fair every cent is worth 7 points. How many points can Ida score?

In the morning Lena runs 3 stretches of 95 minutes each, nearly five hours of running, but she cuts 18 minutes off with a shortcut. She runs this way every morning for 8 days, resting for half an hour afterwards. In the afternoon of the last day she jogs 26 more minutes, and in the evening she runs another 47 minutes. How many minutes has Lena run in total?

Max had 51 dollars. He spent 11 dollars on a book. His friend Nia, who had less money than Max afterwards, paid him back 31 dollars. He then spent 68 dollars on a coat, leaving him 3 dollars, that is three hundred cents. At the arcade every dollar bought 8 tokens. Max shared his tokens equally among 4 games. How many tokens did Max use on the first game?

Ola sows 24 seeds in each row, 3 rows in each bed, and has 5 beds in her garden, which she waters twice a day. She also sowed 66 seeds in pots and 5 seeds in a window box. How many seeds did Ola sow altogether?

A farmer had 41 sheep. He bought 51 more at the spring market. 8 sheep were sold to a neighbour. The farm is 20 hectares. He then bought 80 sheep from a farm that was closing, and 4 lambs were born. How many sheep does the farmer have now?

Quin earns 231 cents a day at the newsstand plus 16 cents a day in tips, and spends 99 cents a day on lunch. He saves the rest for 8 days, which comes to a little under twelve dollars. His uncle adds 28 cents. Quin then spends 1026 cents on a game. How many cents does Quin have left?

Ola collected 234 cans, but the depot rejected 114 of them. The depot is 3 kilometres away. It paid 7 cents for every can it accepted. Ola shared the money equally among herself, Pat and Quin, so Ola's share was exactly the same as Pat's. Ola's father then gave her 3 cents for every cent in her share. How many cents did Ola get from her father?

Tia had 14 cents. She spent 12 cents on a sweet and lost 1 cent through a hole in her pocket. Her brother gave her 4 cents. At the fair every cent she had bought 2 tokens. A friend then gave her 14 tokens. How many tokens does Tia have?

Abe earns 212 cents an hour at the garage plus 51 cents an hour in tips. He works 3 hours a day for 7 days, which comes to a little over fifty-five dollars. His friend Bea, who works half as many hours, earns less per hour than Abe. Abe then spends 4886 cents on boots. At the fair every cent he has left buys 6 tokens, and every token scores 4 points on the ring toss. How many points can Abe score?

A bird sanctuary had 238 birds. 79 birds arrived during the migration, and then 105 flew away. The sanctuary covers 12 hectares. 13 birds were moved to a zoo, and 175 flew south. Then 24 birds hatched, and 37 more were released into the wild. How many birds are at the sanctuary now?

Dan collects 109 cans every day from the park, 33 cans from the beach, and 65 cans from the school, spending about half an hour at each place. The bins are emptied at 7. He does this for 3 days, and on the last day a neighbour gives him 65 cans. How many cans has Dan collected?

Gus sells 7 bookmarks at 27 cents each and spends 80 cents on a drink. His stall is 2 metres wide. His mother then gives him twice what he has, doubling his money. At the fair every cent buys 4 tokens, every token scores 7 points, and every point earns 3 stars. How many stars does Gus earn?

In the morning a grocer unpacked 8 crates with 121 pears in each, and a farmer brought 71 more pears. In the afternoon 93 pears were sold. In the evening 65 pears arrived from an orchard, and then a neighbour dropped off 17 more. How many pears did the grocer have at the end of the evening?

In the morning Eli had 149 cents and spent 91 cents on a bus ticket. At the arcade every cent he had left bought 6 tokens, and he won 33 tokens on the first machine. In the afternoon he spent 124 tokens on racing games and 138 tokens on a claw machine, while his friend Fay had fewer tokens than Eli. In the evening the arcade replaced every token Eli still had with 2 tokens. How many tokens does Eli have?

Gia had 74 cans for the recycling drive. She threw out 38 that were crushed. Her friend Hal, who had collected fewer cans than Gia, gave her 39 cans. The depot pays 8 cents for every can. Gia collected exactly the same number of cans each week for 5 weeks. She then received a 50-cent bonus. How many cents did Gia receive?

A jar held 150 sweets. Ivo's class ate 83 sweets at the party, and 34 sweets were given to the teachers, who check the jar twice a week. Then 15 sweets were added from another jar. The rest were shared equally among 4 helpers. How many sweets did Ivo, one of the helpers, get?

A shelf in the shop held 136 candles. On Monday 30 candles were sold. On Tuesday 85 were sent to a wedding. On Wednesday 4 candles were broken and thrown away. On Thursday 7 candles were sold, and on Friday 1 more was sold. How many candles are on the shelf now?
